title: Loading-context-spacesuit (predicating-regime extension morphism; ω < κ < ω₁)
description: Regime: transfinite-predication-category (predicating morphism, ω < κ < ω₁). Morphism: (agent, context-spacesuit) → agent with loaded fiber. Variance: extension (⊙). Per lab/.../discourse-domain-locus/library/technology/context-spacesuit/context-spacesuit.md: 'Loading the suit is extension (⊙) — adding the agent's context to the bare world.' Closure ordinal κ < ω₁ because suit-loading may require ω-many composition steps as nested skills/rules saturate (rules referencing other rules, skills depending on other skills) but converges below ω₁. The output is the same agent entity with its predication fiber extended by the suit's content; the suit's content does not replace the agent's identity, it composes with it.
